verification.layout: CSS bytes unchanged; desktop 1440x1000 and mobile 390x844 show no horizontal overflow and the catalog begins within the initial viewport. No pixel comparison or manual screenshot inspection is claimed.

initial_findings.finding: The first catalog run rejected a stale content-bound script cache identity after the script changed.
initial_findings.correction: Updated the index script query hash; retained the assertion.

initial_findings.finding: The first real browser run saw the historical fixture clock affect the next viewport current-time case.
initial_findings.correction: Use a fresh browser for each viewport; historical fixtures are explicitly labeled.

initial_findings.finding: The first full run passed 73/74 Node checks; browser cleanup assertion included another live Pester output directory in the shared parent.
initial_findings.correction: Independently verify the exact browser operation directory is absent; do not own the shared parent.

initial_findings.finding: Node experimental coverage creates a temporary directory before test helpers run. Its initial default-temp directory was removed by Node; no node-coverage directory remained in the service account temp listing.
initial_findings.correction: The corrected full-run parent TMP/TEMP/TMPDIR points into an exclusively owned canonical artifact directory, removed after the child closes.
